reuse.why: Extends the tree's existing WeekendRule abstraction (applyWeekendRule, isSkippedWeekendOccurrence) with a holidays field and an internal isNonBusinessDay predicate, so all consumers pick up holidays without new call-site logic.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; only the lookahead/padding sizes are adjusted at three sites, and getUpcomingDates keeps its pre-existing inline daily-skip check.

placement.why: The holiday rule lives inside the shared weekend-rule functions in shared/schedules.ts; the type and parseRecurDate carry the field.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its type plumbing and tests.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; the per-site holiday-count padding heuristics are scattered magic numbers a maintainer must keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites go through applyWeekendRule/isSkippedWeekendOccurrence; getNextDate's find now uses isNonBusinessDay.

one_place.where: isNonBusinessDay used by applyWeekendRule and isSkippedWeekendOccurrence in shared/schedules.ts; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all route through them.
